import TorusEuler.EndpointPhysicalMeanEstimate
import TorusEuler.EndpointPhysicalInverseCaps
import TorusEuler.EndpointL2Coercivity

/-! The endpoint estimates and inverse statements of the frozen torus paper. -/

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace

namespace TorusEuler

noncomputable section

local notation "Time" T => volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)
local notation "Path(" E "," T ")" => Lp E 2 (Time T)

/-- Lemma 4.1 on the whole zero-trace Sobolev space. A displacement `z`
is represented by the primitive of its mean-zero `L²` derivative `v`.
The two right sides use the physical displacement derivative. -/
theorem paper_mean_hardy {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hT₁ : T ≤ 1)
    {F M Mt : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E}
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F ((M t).comp (F t)) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt M (Mt t) (Icc 0 T) t)
    (hMt : ContinuousOn Mt (Icc 0 T))
    (hUpper : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x : E, ⟪endpointHessian (M t) (Mt t) x, x⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (v : Path(E,T)) (hv : endpointIntegral T v = 0) :
    let z := endpointPrimitive v
    let ξ := fun t => F t (z t)
    let dξ := fun t => endpointDisplacementDerivative (F t) (M t) (z t) (v t)
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ⟪endpointHessian (M t) (Mt t) (ξ t), ξ t⟫_ℝ) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖dξ t‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖dξ t‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, endpointLabelEnergy (F t) (M t) (z t) (v t) := by
  intro z ξ dξ
  have cF : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T) := fun t ht => (hF t ht).continuousWithinAt
  have cM : ContinuousOn M (Icc 0 T) := fun t ht => (hM t ht).continuousWithinAt
  let H (t : ℝ) := endpointHessian (M t) (Mt t)
  have cH : ContinuousOn H (Icc 0 T) := (hMt.add (cM.clm_comp cM)).neg
  let A := endpointTimeMultiplier F cF
  let B := endpointTimeMultiplier M cM
  let C := endpointTimeMultiplier H cH
  let X := A.comp (endpointPrimitiveLp hT.le)
  let D : Path(E,T) →L[ℝ] Path(E,T) := B.comp X + A
  have hX (w : Path(E,T)) : (X w : ℝ → E) =ᵐ[Time T] fun t => F t (endpointPrimitive w t) := by
    filter_upwards [endpointTimeMultiplier_apply_ae F cF (endpointPrimitiveLp hT.le w),
      endpointPrimitiveLp_apply_ae hT.le w] with t h1 h2
    change A (endpointPrimitiveLp hT.le w) t = _ at h1
    change A (endpointPrimitiveLp hT.le w) t = _
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hD (w : Path(E,T)) : (D w : ℝ → E) =ᵐ[Time T] fun t =>
      endpointDisplacementDerivative (F t) (M t) (endpointPrimitive w t) (w t) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add (B (X w)) (A w), endpointTimeMultiplier_apply_ae M cM (X w),
      endpointTimeMultiplier_apply_ae F cF w, hX w] with t hadd h1 h2 hx
    change B (X w) t = _ at h1
    change A w t = _ at h2
    change (B (X w) + A w) t = _
    rw [hadd, Pi.add_apply, h1, h2, hx]
    rfl
  have hDnorm (w : Path(E,T)) {g : ℝ → E} (hg : w =ᵐ[Time T] g) :
      ‖D w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T,
        ‖endpointDisplacementDerivative (F t) (M t) (endpointPrimitive g t) (g t)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, L2.inner_def, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hD w, hg, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t hd he ht
    change ⟪D w t, D w t⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [hd, endpointPrimitive_congr_ae hg (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht), he, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hHenergy (w : Path(E,T)) {g : ℝ → E} (hg : w =ᵐ[Time T] g) :
      ⟪C (X w), X w⟫_ℝ = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T,
        ⟪H t (F t (endpointPrimitive g t)), F t (endpointPrimitive g t)⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [L2.inner_def, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [endpointTimeMultiplier_apply_ae H cH (X w), hX w,
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t hm hx ht
    change C (X w) t = _ at hm
    change ⟪C (X w) t, X w t⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [hm, hx, endpointPrimitive_congr_ae hg (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht)]
  let good : Set (Path(E,T)) := {w |
    ⟪C (X w), X w⟫_ℝ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D w‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D w‖ ^ 2 ≤ endpointL2Energy hT.le F M cF cM w}
  have hDcont : Continuous (fun w => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D w‖ ^ 2) :=
    continuous_const.mul (D.continuous.norm.pow 2)
  have hGood : IsClosed good :=
    (isClosed_le ((C.continuous.comp X.continuous).inner X.continuous) hDcont).inter
      (isClosed_le hDcont (continuous_endpointL2Energy hT.le F M cF cM))
  have hSmooth : {w : Path(E,T) | ∃ g : ℝ → E, (w : ℝ → E) =ᵐ[Time T] g ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ (∫ t, g t ∂Time T) = 0} ⊆ good := by
    rintro w ⟨g, hw, hg, hmean⟩
    have hz (t : ℝ) (_ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
        HasDerivWithinAt (endpointPrimitive g) (g t) (Icc 0 T) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_endpointPrimitive hg.continuous t).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hzT : endpointPrimitive g T = 0 := by
      simpa only [endpointPrimitive, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le] using hmean
    change ⟪C (X w), X w⟫_ℝ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D w‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D w‖ ^ 2 ≤ endpointL2Energy hT.le F M cF cM w
    rw [hDnorm w hw, hHenergy w hw, endpointL2Energy_eq_integral hT.le cF cM hw]
    refine ⟨?_, endpointLabelEnergy_coercive hT.le hT₁ hF hM hz hMt
      hg.continuous.continuousOn (by simp [endpointPrimitive]) hzT hUpper⟩
    let x := fun t => F t (endpointPrimitive g t)
    let dx := fun t => endpointDisplacementDerivative (F t) (M t) (endpointPrimitive g t) (g t)
    have cx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 T) :=
      cF.clm_apply (fun t ht => (hz t ht).continuousWithinAt)
    have cdx : ContinuousOn dx (Icc 0 T) :=
      (cM.clm_apply cx).add (cF.clm_apply hg.continuous.continuousOn)
    have hx (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : HasDerivWithinAt x (dx t) (Icc 0 T) t :=
      hasDerivWithinAt_endpointDisplacement (hF t ht) (hz t ht)
    have hXend : x T = 0 := by simp [x, hzT]
    have iH : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ⟪H t (x t), x t⟫_ℝ) volume 0 T := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le hT.le] using (cH.clm_apply cx).inner cx
    have ix : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖x t‖ ^ 2) volume 0 T := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [uIcc_of_le hT.le]
      exact (continuous_pow 2).comp_continuousOn cx.norm
    have hp := terminal_poincare_integral hT.le hXend cdx hx
    have hdx : 0 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖dx t‖ ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall hT.le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hT₂ : T ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hT.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hT₁)]
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hT.le iH ix (fun t ht => hUpper t ht (x t))).trans
      (hp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT₂ hdx))
  have hc := closure_minimal hSmooth hGood
  rw [closure_smooth_meanZero_L2 hT] at hc
  have h := hc hv
  change ⟪C (X v), X v⟫_ℝ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D v‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖D v‖ ^ 2 ≤ endpointL2Energy hT.le F M cF cM v at h
  rw [hDnorm v EventuallyEq.rfl, hHenergy v EventuallyEq.rfl,
    endpointL2Energy_eq_integral hT.le cF cM EventuallyEq.rfl] at h
  exact h


section Integrated

local notation "A" => UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)
local notation "C½" => HalfHolder A Vec3
local notation "K½" => HalfHolder A (Vec3 →L[ℝ] Vec3)
local notation "S" => endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal

local instance paperMeanSolenoidalNormedGroup : NormedAddCommGroup S := inferInstance
local instance paperMeanSolenoidalNormedSpace : NormedSpace ℝ S := inferInstance
local notation "Mixed(" T ")" => HalfHolder A (Path(Vec3,T))
local notation "MixedCoefficient(" T ")" => HalfHolder A (Path(Vec3,T) →L[ℝ] Path(Vec3,T))
local notation "P" => endpointStrongSpatialProjection
local notation "P[" T "]" => endpointStrongMixedLeray T
local notation "W[" T "]" => freezingFixedSpace (P[T])

/-- The integrated momentum expression on the left of (4.9). -/
def paperMeanIntegratedMomentum (K Ω : ℝ → K½) (src : ℝ → C½)
    (v : ℝ → S) (t : ℝ) : C½ :=
  (K t).coefficientMul (v t).val -
    endpointPrimitive (fun r => (Ω r).coefficientMul (v r).val) t + src t

/-- The velocity form of (4.9). The displacement is the primitive of the
velocity and the projected constant is the solenoidal part of the momentum. -/
structure PaperMeanIntegratedSolution (T : ℝ) (K Ω : ℝ → K½) (src : ℝ → C½) where
  velocity : ℝ → S
  constant : S
  continuous : ContinuousOn velocity (Icc 0 T)
  terminal : endpointPrimitive velocity T = 0
  projected : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, P (paperMeanIntegratedMomentum K Ω src velocity t) = constant

private theorem continuousOn_paperMeanIntegratedMomentum {T : ℝ} {K Ω : ℝ → K½}
    {src : ℝ → C½}
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc 0 T)) (hΩ : ContinuousOn Ω (Icc 0 T))
    (hsrc : ContinuousOn src (Icc 0 T)) {g : ℝ → S} (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc 0 T)) :
    ContinuousOn (paperMeanIntegratedMomentum K Ω src g) (Icc 0 T) := by
  let gv : ℝ → C½ := fun t => (g t).val
  have hgc : ContinuousOn gv (Icc 0 T) :=
    endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hg
  have hKc := (HalfHolder.coefficientMulL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hK).clm_apply hgc
  have hΩc := (HalfHolder.coefficientMulL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hΩ).clm_apply hgc
  have hI : ContinuousOn (endpointPrimitive (fun r => (Ω r).coefficientMul (gv r))) (Icc 0 T) :=
    fun t ht => (hasDerivWithinAt_endpointPrimitive_of_continuousOn hΩc ht).continuousWithinAt
  exact (hKc.sub hI).add hsrc

/-- Existence of the normalized spatial potential in (4.9), with its
gradient represented by a continuous curve in the spatial Hölder norm. -/
theorem PaperMeanIntegratedSolution.exists_potential {T : ℝ} {K Ω : ℝ → K½}
    {src : ℝ → C½}
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc 0 T)) (hΩ : ContinuousOn Ω (Icc 0 T))
    (hsrc : ContinuousOn src (Icc 0 T)) (s : PaperMeanIntegratedSolution T K Ω src) :
    ∃ (φ : Pressure) (Gφ : ℝ → C½), ContinuousOn Gφ (Icc 0 T) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, SpatiallyPeriodic (φ t) ∧ (∫ x in centeredCell, φ t x) = 0 ∧
        (∀ x, HasGradientAt (φ t) (HalfHolder.eval (toUnitTorus x) (Gφ t)) x) ∧
        paperMeanIntegratedMomentum K Ω src s.velocity t = (s.constant : C½) + Gφ t := by
  let f := paperMeanIntegratedMomentum K Ω src s.velocity
  let G (t : ℝ) := f t - (s.constant : C½)
  have hex (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
      ∃ p : Vec3 → ℝ, SpatiallyPeriodic p ∧ (∫ x in centeredCell, p x) = 0 ∧
        ∀ x, HasGradientAt p (HalfHolder.eval (toUnitTorus x) (G t)) x := by
    apply exists_endpointPressure_of_projected_equation (f t) s.constant
    rw [endpointStrongSpatialProjection_agrees_weak, s.projected t ht]
  choose φ hφ using hex
  classical
  refine ⟨fun t => if ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T then φ t ht else 0, G,
    (continuousOn_paperMeanIntegratedMomentum hK hΩ hsrc s.continuous).sub continuousOn_const,
    fun t ht => ?_⟩
  simp only [dite_eq_left ht]
  obtain ⟨hp, hm, hg⟩ := hφ t ht
  exact ⟨hp, hm, hg, by change f t = _; dsimp only [G]; abel⟩

private theorem paperMean_mixed_fixed {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {v : ℝ → S} {w : Mixed(T)}
    (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T)) (hEnd : endpointPrimitive v T = 0)
    (hRep : EndpointMixedRepresents w (fun t => (v t).val)) :
    P[T] w = w := by
  let joint := endpointMixedToJoint T w
  have hvc : ContinuousOn (fun t => (v t).val) (Icc 0 T) :=
    endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hv
  have hSlice := hRep.spatialSlice hT.le hvc
  have hConst (a : A) : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, HalfHolder.eval a (v t).val) = 0 := by
    let : CompleteSpace S := isClosed_endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.completeSpace_coe
    let ev := (HalfHolder.eval a).comp endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable v volume 0 T :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (u := v) hT.le hv
    change (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ev (v t)) = 0
    rw [ev.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi]
    change ev (endpointPrimitive v T) = 0
    rw [hEnd, map_zero]
  have hMem : joint ∈ endpointTorusSpace T := by
    apply (mem_endpointTorusSpace_iff_slices T joint).mpr
    constructor
    · filter_upwards [endpointMixedToJoint_apply_ae w, hRep] with a hwa ha
      change (∫ t, joint (t, a) ∂Time T) = 0
      rw [integral_congr_ae (hwa.symm.trans ha), ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le]
      exact hConst a
    · intro p
      filter_upwards [endpointSpatialSlice_apply_ae joint, hSlice,
        ae_restrict_mem (μ := volume) (measurableSet_Ioc (a := 0) (b := T))] with t ht hst htm
      have hp := (mem_endpointSpatialSolenoidal (endpointHalfHolderToL2 (v t).val)).mp
        (v t).property p
      rw [← hst] at hp
      exact (integral_congr_ae (ht.symm.mono fun a ha => congrArg
        (fun q => ⟪endpointPotentialGradient p a, q⟫_ℝ) ha)).trans hp
  apply endpointMixedToJoint_injective T
  rw [endpointStrongMixedLeray_agrees_L2 hT, endpointJointConstraintProjection]
  let : CompleteSpace (endpointTorusSpace T) := (isClosed_endpointTorusSpace T).completeSpace_coe
  exact Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr hMem

private theorem paperMean_mixed_projection_of_constant {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {r : Mixed(T)} {f : ℝ → C½}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 T)) (hRep : EndpointMixedRepresents r f) (c : S)
    (hConstant : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, P (f t) = c) : P[T] r = 0 := by
  let R := endpointMixedToJoint T r
  let C := endpointHalfHolderToL2 c.val
  have hSlice := hRep.spatialSlice hT.le hf
  have hOrth (v : endpointTorusSpace T) : ⟪R, (v : EndpointTorusL2 T)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    let w : EndpointTorusL2 T := v
    have hSol := ae_endpointSpatialSlice_solenoidal v.property
    have hEq : ∀ᵐ t ∂Time T,
        (∫ a, ⟪R (t, a), w (t, a)⟫_ℝ ∂unitTorusMeasure) = ⟪C, endpointSpatialSlice w t⟫_ℝ := by
      filter_upwards [endpointSpatialSlice_apply_ae R, endpointSpatialSlice_apply_ae w, hSlice,
        hSol, ae_restrict_mem (μ := volume) (measurableSet_Ioc (a := 0) (b := T))]
        with t ha hb ht htSol hmem
      let : CompleteSpace endpointSpatialSolenoidal := isClosed_endpointSpatialSolenoidal.completeSpace_coe
      let y : endpointSpatialSolenoidal := ⟨endpointSpatialSlice w t, htSol⟩
      have hProj : endpointWeakSpatialProjection (endpointSpatialSlice R t) =
          endpointSolenoidalEmbedding c := by
        rw [ht, endpointStrongSpatialProjection_agrees_weak, hConstant t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hmem)]
      have hi := endpointSpatialSolenoidal.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_right
        y (endpointSpatialSlice R t)
      change ⟪(endpointWeakSpatialProjection (endpointSpatialSlice R t) : Lp Vec3 2 unitTorusMeasure),
        endpointSpatialSlice w t⟫_ℝ = _ at hi
      rw [hProj] at hi
      change ⟪C, endpointSpatialSlice w t⟫_ℝ = ⟪endpointSpatialSlice R t, endpointSpatialSlice w t⟫_ℝ at hi
      rw [L2.inner_def (endpointSpatialSlice R t) (endpointSpatialSlice w t)] at hi
      refine (integral_congr_ae ?_).trans hi.symm
      filter_upwards [ha, hb] with a hfa hga
      rw [hfa, hga]
    have hm : endpointTorusTimeIntegral hT.le w = 0 := by
      apply (endpointTorusTimeIntegral_eq_zero_iff hT.le w).mpr
      filter_upwards [((mem_endpointTorusSpace_iff_slices T w).mp v.property).1] with a ha
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le]
      exact ha
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    change (∫ q, ⟪R q, w q⟫_ℝ ∂(Time T).prod unitTorusMeasure) = 0
    rw [integral_prod _ (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) R w), integral_congr_ae hEq]
    have hSwap : (∫ t, ⟪C, endpointSpatialSlice w t⟫_ℝ ∂Time T) =
        ∫ t, ⟪endpointSpatialSlice w t, C⟫_ℝ ∂Time T :=
      integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun t => real_inner_comm _ _)
    rw [hSwap, integral_inner_endpointSpatialSlice hT.le, hm, inner_zero_left]
  apply endpointMixedToJoint_injective T
  rw [endpointStrongMixedLeray_agrees_L2 hT, map_zero]
  let : CompleteSpace (endpointTorusSpace T) := (isClosed_endpointTorusSpace T).completeSpace_coe
  let pr : endpointTorusSpace T := (endpointTorusSpace T).orthogonalProjectionOnto R
  have he := (endpointTorusSpace T).inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_right pr R
  change ⟪(pr : EndpointTorusL2 T), (pr : EndpointTorusL2 T)⟫_ℝ = _ at he
  rw [hOrth pr, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at he
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp he)


private theorem paperMean_mixed_solution_eq {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (Kmix Ωmix : MixedCoefficient(T))
    (eM : W[T] ≃L[ℝ] W[T])
    (heM : (eM : W[T] →L[ℝ] W[T]) = freezingCompression P[T]
      (endpointMixedPathCoefficient hT.le Kmix Ωmix).coefficientMul (endpointStrongMixedLeray_idempotent hT))
    (f w z : Mixed(T)) (hw : P[T] w = w) (hz : P[T] z = z)
    (hProjW : P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix w + f) = 0)
    (hProjZ : P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix z + f) = 0) : w = z := by
  let a : W[T] := ⟨w, (mem_freezingFixedSpace P[T] w).mpr hw⟩
  let b : W[T] := ⟨z, (mem_freezingFixedSpace P[T] z).mpr hz⟩
  suffices h : eM a = eM b from congrArg (fun y : W[T] => y.val) (eM.injective h)
  apply Subtype.ext
  have calcEq (u : W[T]) (hu : P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix u.val + f) = 0) :
      (eM u).val = -(P[T] f) := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun x : W[T] => x.val) (DFunLike.congr_fun heM u)
    have hc := DFunLike.congr_fun (endpointMixedPathCoefficient_coefficientMul hT.le Kmix Ωmix) u.val
    rw [map_add] at hu
    exact hm.trans ((congrArg (P[T]) hc).trans (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hu))
  exact (calcEq a hProjW).trans (calcEq b hProjZ).symm

private theorem PaperMeanIntegratedSolution.exists_mixed_representation
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {K Ω : ℝ → K½} {src : ℝ → C½}
    (Kmix Ωmix : MixedCoefficient(T)) (f : Mixed(T))
    (hK : ContinuousOn K (Icc 0 T)) (hΩ : ContinuousOn Ω (Icc 0 T))
    (hsrc : ContinuousOn src (Icc 0 T))
    (hKmix : ∀ (a : A) (v : Path(Vec3,T)), (fun t => HalfHolder.eval a Kmix v t) =ᵐ[Time T]
      fun t => HalfHolder.eval a (K t) (v t))
    (hΩmix : ∀ (a : A) (v : Path(Vec3,T)), (fun t => HalfHolder.eval a Ωmix v t) =ᵐ[Time T]
      fun t => HalfHolder.eval a (Ω t) (v t))
    (hf : EndpointMixedRepresents f src) (s : PaperMeanIntegratedSolution T K Ω src) :
    ∃ w : Mixed(T), EndpointMixedRepresents w (fun t => (s.velocity t).val) ∧ P[T] w = w ∧
      P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix w + f) = 0 := by
  let gv : ℝ → C½ := fun t => (s.velocity t).val
  have hgc : ContinuousOn gv (Icc 0 T) :=
    endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL.continuous.comp_continuousOn s.continuous
  let M := endpointClosedTimeNorm T gv
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw, _⟩ := exists_endpointMixedSource hT.le
    (endpointClosedTimeNorm_nonneg hT.le gv) gv hgc
    (fun _ => norm_le_endpointClosedTimeNorm hgc)
  have hRep : EndpointMixedRepresents w gv := ae_of_all _ hw
  have hFixed := paperMean_mixed_fixed hT s.continuous s.terminal hRep
  have hKrep := hRep.coefficientMul (ae_of_all _ hKmix)
  have hΩrep := hRep.coefficientMul (ae_of_all _ hΩmix)
  have hΩc := (HalfHolder.coefficientMulL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hΩ).clm_apply hgc
  have hRrep := (hKrep.sub (hΩrep.integration hT.le hΩc)).add hf
  have hRc := continuousOn_paperMeanIntegratedMomentum hK hΩ hsrc s.continuous
  exact ⟨w, hRep, hFixed, paperMean_mixed_projection_of_constant hT hRc hRrep s.constant s.projected⟩

/-- The sum of the coframe and velocity-gradient controls and the spatial
zeroth- and first-order kinetic and vorticity controls in (4.10). -/
def paperMeanBaseScale (D L CK CΩ LK LΩ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  D + L + CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ

theorem paperMean_inverse_scale {D L CK CΩ LK LΩ : ℝ}
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCK : 0 ≤ CK) (hCΩ : 0 ≤ CΩ)
    (hLK : 0 ≤ LK) (hLΩ : 0 ≤ LΩ) :
    let Q := paperMeanBaseScale D L CK CΩ LK LΩ
    1 ≤ Q ∧
      4 + D ^ 2 + 2 * D ^ 2 * (1 + L) ^ 2 + CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ ≤ 16 * Q ^ 4 := by
  intro Q
  have hQ : 1 ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q, paperMeanBaseScale]; linarith
  have hDq : D ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q, paperMeanBaseScale]; linarith
  have hLq : L ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q, paperMeanBaseScale]; linarith
  have hQ₂ : Q ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ (by norm_num)
  have hQ₄ : Q ≤ Q ^ 4 := by simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ (show 1 ≤ 4 by decide)
  have hD₂ : D ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (zero_le_one.trans hD) hDq _
  have hL₂ : (1 + L) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Q) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) _
  have hK : 2 * D ^ 2 * (1 + L) ^ 2 ≤ 8 * Q ^ 4 :=
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * Q ^ 2 * (2 * Q) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD₂ zero_le_two) hL₂ (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hC : CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q, paperMeanBaseScale]; linarith
  exact ⟨hQ, by linarith [hD₂.trans hQ₂, hQ.trans hQ₄, hC.trans hQ₄]⟩

/-- The integrated Hölder inverse of Theorem A.1 on a slab of length at
most one, together with the fixed-time inverse. These two inverses have
one coefficient-dependent cap independent of the slab duration and source. -/
theorem paperMeanIntegratedInverse_of_coercivity :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ {T μ μmix CK CΩ LK LΩ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T), T ≤ 1 →
      0 < μ → 0 < μmix → 0 ≤ CK → 0 ≤ CΩ → 0 ≤ LK → 0 ≤ LΩ →
      ∀ (K Ω : ℝ → K½) (Kmix Ωmix : MixedCoefficient(T)),
      ContinuousOn K (Icc 0 T) → ContinuousOn Ω (Icc 0 T) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖K t‖ ≤ CK) → (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖Ω t‖ ≤ CΩ) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ a b, ‖HalfHolder.eval a (K t) - HalfHolder.eval b (K t)‖ ≤ LK * dist a b) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ a b, ‖HalfHolder.eval a (Ω t) - HalfHolder.eval b (Ω t)‖ ≤ LΩ * dist a b) →
      (∀ (a : A) (v : Path(Vec3,T)), (fun t => HalfHolder.eval a Kmix v t) =ᵐ[Time T]
        fun t => HalfHolder.eval a (K t) (v t)) →
      (∀ (a : A) (v : Path(Vec3,T)), (fun t => HalfHolder.eval a Ωmix v t) =ᵐ[Time T]
        fun t => HalfHolder.eval a (Ω t) (v t)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ a v, μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪HalfHolder.eval a (K t) v, v⟫_ℝ) →
      (∀ a (v : Path(Vec3,T)), endpointIntegral T v = 0 →
        μmix * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
          ⟪HalfHolder.eval a (endpointMixedPathCoefficient hT.le Kmix Ωmix) v, v⟫_ℝ) →
      let cap := C * (4 + μ⁻¹ + μmix⁻¹ + CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ) ^ (291 : ℕ)
      (∃ e : ℝ → S ≃L[ℝ] S,
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ v : S, e t v = P ((K t).coefficientMul v.val)) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖((e t).symm : S →L[ℝ] S).comp P‖ ≤ cap) ∧
      ∀ src : ℝ → C½, ContinuousOn src (Icc 0 T) →
      ∃ s : PaperMeanIntegratedSolution T K Ω src,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (endpointPrimitive s.velocity) (Icc 0 T) ∧
        endpointPrimitive s.velocity 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt (endpointPrimitive s.velocity) (s.velocity t) (Icc 0 T) t) ∧
        endpointClosedTimeNorm T s.velocity ≤ cap * endpointClosedTimeNorm T src ∧
        ∀ u : PaperMeanIntegratedSolution T K Ω src,
          EqOn u.velocity s.velocity (Icc 0 T) ∧ u.constant = s.constant := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Cmain, hCmain, hid⟩ := exists_endpointPhysicalInverseCaps 1 (C₀ := 1) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨Cinstant, hCinstant, hinstant⟩ := exists_endpointSpatialSolenoidalInverse
  let Cfix := Cinstant * ‖P‖
  let C := Cmain + Cfix
  have hCfix : 0 ≤ Cfix := by dsimp only [Cfix]; positivity
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg hCmain hCfix
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro T μ μmix CK CΩ LK LΩ hT hT₁ hμ hμmix hCK hCΩ hLK hLΩ K Ω Kmix Ωmix
    hK hΩ bK bΩ lK lΩ kmix omix hEll hCoerc cap
  let Q : ℝ := 4 + μ⁻¹ + μmix⁻¹ + CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ
  have hQ : 1 ≤ Q := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    linarith only [inv_nonneg.mpr hμ.le, inv_nonneg.mpr hμmix.le, hCK, hCΩ, hLK, hLΩ]
  have hScale' : 4 + μ⁻¹ + μmix⁻¹ + CK + CΩ + LK + LΩ ≤ 1 * Q ^ 1 := by
    simp only [pow_one, one_mul, Q, le_refl]
  obtain ⟨eS, eM, As, Am, heS, hAs, heM, hAm, hBudget⟩ :=
    hid hT hT₁ hQ Kmix Ωmix K Ω hK hΩ kmix omix hCK hCΩ hLK hLΩ bK bΩ lK lΩ hμ hμmix
      hEll hCoerc hScale'
  have hKsup (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
      ‖(K t).val.1‖ ≤ CK := by
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le hCK).mpr
    exact ((HalfHolder.norm_le_iff hCK).mp (bK t ht)).1
  refine ⟨⟨eS, heS, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨e, he, hb⟩ := hinstant (K t) hμ hLK (lK t ht) (hEll t ht)
    have heq : eS t = e := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ext (funext fun v => (heS t ht v).trans (he v).symm)
    rw [heq]
    have hF : 4 + μ⁻¹ + ‖(K t).val.1‖ + LK ≤ Q := by
      dsimp only [Q]
      linarith only [hKsup t ht, hCΩ, hLΩ, inv_nonneg.mpr hμmix.le]
    have hlow : 0 ≤ 4 + μ⁻¹ + ‖(K t).val.1‖ + LK := by positivity
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(e.symm : S →L[ℝ] S)‖ * ‖P‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ ≤ Cinstant * Q ^ 145 * ‖P‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ hlow hF _) hCinstant))) endpointStrongSpatialProjection.opNorm_nonneg
      _ = Cfix * Q ^ (145 : ℕ) := by dsimp only [Cfix]; rw [mul_right_comm]
      _ ≤ cap := by
        change _ ≤ C * Q ^ (291 : ℕ)
        exact mul_le_mul (le_add_of_nonneg_left hCmain)
          (pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ (by decide)) (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hQ) _) hC
  · intro src hsrc
    let Csrc := endpointClosedTimeNorm T src
    have hCsrc : 0 ≤ Csrc := endpointClosedTimeNorm_nonneg hT.le src
    have hSbound (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : ‖src t‖ ≤ Csrc := norm_le_endpointClosedTimeNorm hsrc ht
    obtain ⟨f, _, hFrep, hFs⟩ := exists_endpointMixedSource hT.le hCsrc src hsrc hSbound
    let p : W[T] := ⟨P[T] f, (mem_freezingFixedSpace P[T] _).mpr (endpointStrongMixedLeray_idempotent hT f)⟩
    let w₁ := eM.symm (-p)
    let w := w₁.val
    have hFixed : P[T] w = w := (mem_freezingFixedSpace P[T] _).mp w₁.property
    have hProj : P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix w + f) = 0 := by
      have hEq : freezingCompression P[T]
          (endpointMixedPathCoefficient hT.le Kmix Ωmix).coefficientMul (endpointStrongMixedLeray_idempotent hT)
          w₁ = -p := (DFunLike.congr_fun heM w₁).symm.trans (eM.apply_symm_apply _)
      have hP' : P[T] (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix w) = -(P[T] f) := by
        rw [← endpointMixedPathCoefficient_coefficientMul hT.le Kmix Ωmix]
        exact congrArg (fun x : W[T] => x.val) hEq
      rw [map_add, hP', neg_add_cancel]
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hEq, hRep, hStart, hEnd, hDeriv⟩ :=
      exists_endpointMixedTimeRecovery hT Kmix Ωmix w f K src hFixed hProj
        hμ hLK (contDiffOn_zero.mpr hK) lK hEll hKsup hsrc hSbound
        (ae_endpointMixedCoefficient_spatialSlice_of_pathAction K Kmix hK (ae_of_all _ kmix) w) hFs
    let gv : ℝ → C½ := fun t => (g t).val
    have hgc : ContinuousOn gv (Icc 0 T) :=
      endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hg
    have hWrep : EndpointMixedRepresents w gv := EndpointMixedRepresents.of_spatialSlice hT.le hgc hRep
    have hΩrep := hWrep.coefficientMul (ae_of_all _ omix)
    have hΩc := (HalfHolder.coefficientMulL.continuous.comp_continuousOn hΩ).clm_apply hgc
    let c := P (T⁻¹ • HalfHolder.map (endpointPrimitiveEvaluation ⟨T, hT.le, le_rfl⟩)
      (endpointMixedProductOperator hT.le Kmix Ωmix w + f))
    have hEquation (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
        P (paperMeanIntegratedMomentum K Ω src g t) = c := by
      have hEt := hEq ⟨t, ht⟩
      rw [endpointMixedPrimitive_eq_endpointPrimitive _ hΩc hΩrep ⟨t, ht⟩] at hEt
      change P ((K t).coefficientMul (g t).val) =
        c + P (endpointPrimitive (fun r => (Ω r).coefficientMul (g r).val) t) - P (src t) at hEt
      unfold paperMeanIntegratedMomentum
      rw [map_add, map_sub, hEt]
      change c + _ - _ - _ + _ = c
      abel
    let s : PaperMeanIntegratedSolution T K Ω src := ⟨g, c, hg, hEnd, hEquation⟩
    let : CompleteSpace S := isClosed_endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.completeSpace_coe
    refine ⟨s, ?_, hStart, hDeriv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] using
        contDiffOn_endpointPrimitive_succ (n := 0) hT (contDiffOn_zero.mpr hg)
    · apply endpointClosedTimeNorm_le hT.le
      intro t ht
      have hr := norm_endpointPhysicalTimeRepresentative_le hT Kmix Ωmix w f K src g hK hsrc hg
        (ae_of_all _ kmix) (ae_of_all _ hFrep) hWrep hFixed hProj
        hμ hLK lK hEll hKsup eS heS hAs eM heM hAm hCsrc hSbound t ht
      exact hr.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (hBudget.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right hCfix) (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hQ) _))) hCsrc)
    · intro u
      obtain ⟨w', hRep', hFixed', hProjected'⟩ := u.exists_mixed_representation hT Kmix Ωmix f hK hΩ
        hsrc kmix omix (ae_of_all _ hFrep)
      have hEqW := paperMean_mixed_solution_eq hT Kmix Ωmix eM heM f w' w hFixed' hFixed hProjected' hProj
      rw [hEqW] at hRep'
      have hu : ContinuousOn (fun t => (u.velocity t).val) (Icc 0 T) :=
        endpointHalfHolderSolenoidal.subtypeL.continuous.comp_continuousOn u.continuous
      have hv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : u.velocity t = s.velocity t :=
        Subtype.ext ((hRep'.eqOn hT hu hgc hWrep) ht)
      refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_rfl, hT.le⟩
      rw [← u.projected 0 h0, ← s.projected 0 h0]
      simp only [paperMeanIntegratedMomentum, endpointPrimitive, intervalIntegral.integral_same,
        sub_zero, hv 0 h0]

theorem paperMean_projection_gradient_zero (g : C½)
    (q : EndpointSmoothPotential)
    (hq : ∀ x, HalfHolder.eval (toUnitTorus x) g = gradient q.lift x) :
    endpointStrongSpatialProjection g = 0 := by
  have hL2 : endpointHalfHolderToL2 g = (endpointPotentialGradient q).toLp 2 unitTorusMeasure ℝ := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [endpointHalfHolderToL2_apply_ae g,
      ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) unitTorusMeasure (endpointPotentialGradient q)]
      with a h1 h2
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := toUnitTorus_surjective a
    rw [h1, h2, endpointPotentialGradient_toUnitTorus, hq]
  let v : Lp Vec3 2 unitTorusMeasure := endpointHalfHolderToL2 g
  let s := endpointWeakSpatialProjection v
  have hInner : ⟪v, (s : Lp Vec3 2 unitTorusMeasure)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    rw [show v = _ from hL2, L2.inner_def]
    have hEq := (ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) unitTorusMeasure
      (endpointPotentialGradient q)).mono fun a ha =>
        congrArg (fun x : Vec3 => ⟪x, (s : Lp Vec3 2 unitTorusMeasure) a⟫_ℝ) ha
    exact (integral_congr_ae hEq).trans ((mem_endpointSpatialSolenoidal s.val).mp s.property q)
  let : CompleteSpace endpointSpatialSolenoidal := isClosed_endpointSpatialSolenoidal.completeSpace_coe
  have hPr := endpointSpatialSolenoidal.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_right s v
  change ⟪s.val, s.val⟫_ℝ = _ at hPr
  rw [hInner, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hPr
  have hZero : s = 0 := Subtype.ext (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hPr))
  apply endpointSolenoidalEmbedding_injective
  rw [← endpointStrongSpatialProjection_agrees_weak, map_zero]
  exact hZero
